answer: Latency-covariance quorum: each identity joins randomized 5-peer probes seeded by public entropy (walnut auction feed, comet ephemeris, canyon seismograph). Peers timestamp round trips and submit covariance matrices; duplicates sharing host/NAT/ASN produce correlated jitter and are flagged. Attacker must give every sybil an independent network path, clock, and host—cost scales linearly with identities, not one VM.
